entities.summary: The province of Dacia: Roman colonists, mines (Roșia Montană gold), urban centres (Ulpia Traiana Sarmizegetusa, Apulum), and the romanisation that produced the Romanian language. Emperor Aurelian's withdrawal (271 CE) and the Daco-Roman continuity debate.
